title: Air temperature at 2 m
source: NASA GMAO Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2
definition: The average air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

transitions.label: SST/sea-ice boundary data: AMIP II monthly fields -> Reynolds daily OISST
transitions.source: UCAR Climate Data Guide (citing Bosilovich et al. 2015, sec. 8): AMIP II 1980-1981; Reynolds et al. (2007) 1982-Mar 2006; OSTIA Apr 2006-present

transitions.label: Sea-ice input inside Reynolds OISST: NASA GSFC -> NCEP analysis
transitions.source: UCAR Climate Data Guide and NOAA NCEI OISST pages: GSFC sea ice up to 2004, NCEP from 2005. Found first as a jump in MERRA-2 minus NSIDC, then confirmed in the documentation

transitions.label: SST/sea-ice boundary data: Reynolds OISST -> OSTIA
transitions.source: UCAR Climate Data Guide (citing Bosilovich et al. 2015, sec. 8)

status_legend.1: trend detected (FDR) and parametric test agrees
status_legend.3: naive p<0.05 only - would be a false alarm candidate
status_legend.4: not yet detectable - record too short for a trend this size
status_legend.5: inconclusive - trend this size should be detectable but is not significant
status_legend.6: excluded - some months missing (gaps or values masked by the provider)
